I don’t even have to carry a purse.Read More#widget-icon--r6t- path, #widget-icon--r6t- rect { fill: currentColor !important; }Andres G.5.0recently ordered a Tushbaby and I’m honestly so impressed.

With my first baby, I bought a cheaper knock-off because shipping the original to Switzerland felt too expensive. I thought, “How different can it be?” Turns out… very different. My back remembers.

This time, I went for the original and it was completely worth it. I have lower back pain, and the way it shifts the weight off my lower back makes a huge difference.

The pockets are also a lifesaver. Phone, keys, snacks, random toddler treasures, it all fits.

I ordered on a Thursday and it was at my door by Monday, which honestly surprised me (in a good way).

Would definitely recommend.
